title: review_imgs list document (aitools.review_imgs.v1)
description: One throwaway image review list in the `review_imgs` collection of the aidb DB (per profile). The creator writes it once via script/review_list.py; afterwards the aidb app Review tab is the only writer (items[].response, comment). See conf/review/README.md.

list_id.description: Unique, human-readable key of the list.

created.description: Creation time, ISO-ish local time (e.g. 2026-09-26T14:10). Filled by the CLI when absent.

created_by.description: Board username of the creating agent/person.

form.description: Per-image review interface, identical for all items.

comment.description: List-level free comment, written by the app.

url.description: Local file path, as current at creation time. Missing files render as a placeholder.

context.description: Optional free text, shown only if show_context.

response.description: {form key: value} — bool -> true/false, choice -> string, multi -> list of strings, text -> string. Written by the app.
